tei:div.tei:p: (1)dam pa gsum gyi nyams len gnad 'dus bzhugs/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi dmigs pa med/ rjes la bsngo bas yongs su yongs su zin pa 'di/ thar lam bsgrod pa'i gces pa rnam gsum yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ blo sbyong blo sbyong rang gi sems 'di sbyong*/ byang chub sems kyi blo 'di sbyong na ni/ lus ngag dge ba sne gcig ma 'grub yang*/ thar ba'i lam du 'khyug par 'gyur re kan/ zhes pa ltar/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de yi ched du lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor la brtson par bya snyam du tshogs bsags la 'bad par bya'/ gnyis pa/ za nyal 'gro 'dug dge sbyor gang gi skabs na'ang tshogs drug gi yul snang la/ rnam rtog gang shar spang blang dor 'dzin med pa sems nyid stong gsal spros bral yul med rang gsal chen po yengs med du rang ngo skyong bar bya/ (2)skabs su rang ngo ma zin pa dang rnam rtog mang ba sogs byung na rtsa ba'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos mthong gyi mos gus drag pos gsol 'debs kyis gang snang thams cad bla ma'i sku/ grags pa thams cad bla ma'i gsung*/ dran rtog thams cad bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres nas yang yang gom par bya'o/ gsum pa/ dge rtsa thams cad ma rgan sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ji ltar bsngo ba mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis bsngo bar bgyi'o bsnyam du bsngo smon gyis rgyas 'debs bya'o/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi dmigs rim nyung ngu 'di ni blo gros rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis bris pa'o/ rigs dgag a ni chos sgron la gdam pa ste/ kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i phyag bris las bshus pa'o/// /
